children: RMC Switchgears shares will remain in focus on November 25 after the company received Letters of Award (LOAs) worth Rs 521.83 crore for development of distribution infrastructure and system-strengthening works.

The contract involves the supply, testing, transportation, construction, erection, testing and commissioning of new substations, augmentation of existing substations, additional power transformers, HT lines and other allied works. The project is scheduled to be executed over a period of 24 months.

Commenting on the development, Ankit Agarwal, CEO and Whole-time Director of RMC Switchgears, said this is a significant opportunity for RMC to demonstrate its end-to-end execution capability on a complex, utility-grade distribution-infrastructure programme. The ADR package spans the full project lifecycle - from civil works and equipment supply through installation, commissioning and performance assurance - and reinforces our ability to deliver integrated electrical EPC solutions at scale.

He added that, the engagement further builds on our experience in Maharashtra and strengthens our credentials in high-value distribution infrastructure. We remain focused on disciplined execution, rigorous project controls and delivering dependable outcomes for the utility ecosystem.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

On November 19, the company received another LOA worth Rs 18.51 crore from KRYFS Power Components for the manufacture and supply of FSP, MSP, SFU and meter boxes. The order is to be executed over 60 months

The company reported a 47.90 percent year-on-year decline in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 8.32 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 15.96 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. Consolidated revenue declined 35.22 percent to Rs 88.81 crore from Rs 137.08 crore.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 163.61, down Rs 8.84, or 5.13 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 537.00 and a 52-week low of Rs 163.35 on 23 April, 2026 and 23 November, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 69.31 percent below its 52-week high and 0.89 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 173.13 crore.

title: RMC Switchgears shares in focus after bagging Rs 521.83-crore contract
